rows.note: This is the all-purpose personal noun for someone who buys and sells goods for profit.

example.english: This merchant specializes in buying and selling antiques.
example.traditional: 呢個商人專門做古董買賣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng1 jan4 zyun1 mun4 zou6 gu2 dung2 maai5 maai6

rows.note: Use this for the person who owns or runs a shop or other retail business.

example.english: The merchant running this shop is very welcoming.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅老闆好好客。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 haak3

rows.note: Use this when the merchant is viewed as the retail business or commercial establishment rather than its individual owner.

example.english: This merchant is having a big sale today.
example.traditional: 呢間商家今日做緊大減價。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 soeng1 gaa1 gam1 jat6 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3
